The before/after pair uses the exact original frame 3999 pose on current post-park source manifest `bf6200b3`. Both preserve the approved 98 trees, translated office and other scene geometry. Only the ordinary-island/joined-paving delta differs.

The cyan area across the bottom is a diagnostic-renderer omission. It rejects whole triangles that straddle its 0.2 m near plane instead of clipping them, and it omits the car and HUD. The same omission appears in both images. It is not a missing triangle in the source model. The encoded coverage proof reports zero unresolved loss beyond the native encoding band. Fence masking is omitted equally, leaf alpha is 85, and the 220 m view limit and source colors do not reproduce Unreal PBR or shadows.

The 40.427% maximum is one inherited 5.505e-6 m² face. Its exact original owner already has 40.427% grade, and its maximum original-plane deviation is 5.46e-14 m. There are no new substantive steep faces. The previous narrow-junction trial with three real steepened faces remains rejected.

The incoming Niyazi carriageway remains a separate held feature. This pair is not native visual approval or a whole-circuit quality pass.
